label: preparing
what: A surprise bread feast/jubilee for the mayor's forty years of service, with 200 fresh loaves and eight lanterns arranged for the mayor's arrival at the great hall at 18:00 on day 1. The baker knowingly assisted by baking/providing bread and permitting oven use. The neighbour knowingly helped preserve secrecy and was tasked with welcoming/escorting the mayor at the right time. The mayor was not told the event's true nature beforehand, although he was told to attend an 'inn matter' / community supper.
